Elon Musk's Supposed Baby Mama, Ashley St Clair Blew All The Money He Gave Her, Claims She's Broke And Getting Evicted
Elon Musk’s alleged ‘Baby Mama’, Ashley St. Clair reveals she is broke and getting evicted.
The Influencer has launched a podcast titled ‘Bad Advice with Ashley St. Clair’ and has admitted to destroying her own career while revealing she is getting evicted from her luxury apartment.
Musk previously revealed he had given her $2.5 million and was giving her $500,000 per year “despite not knowing for sure” whether the baby was his- but St. Clair has claimed she has no money left.
During the first episode of her podcast, she thanked Polymarket for giving her $10,000 to do an ad read to cover her rent.
“The roof over my head has been brought to you by Polymarket.”
